subject: Hosted API: volume bands, target $/1M & peak concurrency
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Bell <sam.bell@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Sam — thanks again for hopping on the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few items we need to finalize pricing:  

- Goal: integrate Hosted API for customer support augmentation (live chat + summarization) across US customer base.  
- Items we need from you to put together a formal proposal:  
  1) Expected steady-state monthly token volume (low / mid / high bands, ideally three bands).  
  2) Peak TPS (inbound requests per second) during business hours and any burst windows.  
  3) Target budget range for inference (monthly) and an internal target $/1M tokens you want us to hit.  
  4) Any procurement timeline or PO prerequisites from your side.

We can run a sensitivity table once we have the three volume bands and peak TPS. For reference, our Hosted API pricing tiers assume different unit economics at >50M, >250M, and >1B token bands — but we'll layout custom pricing aligned to your target $/1M if the volumes support it.

Next steps: if you can reply with the bands and an estimate of peak TPS, I'll draft a proposal + an initial SOW and send to procurement for review. If it's easier, attach a CSV export of a recent traffic sample and we'll run a quick TPS projection.

Thanks,
Grace
Product Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Bell <sam.bell@blueharbor.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.ai
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's demo

Hi Grace — great demo, thanks. Per your ask please find our initial estimates below and I've attached a week-long traffic extract (blueharbor_traffic_sample.csv).

- Expected monthly token volume (estimates):
  • Low: 40M tokens/month (pilot, one region)
  • Mid: 220M tokens/month (rollout to national support hours)
  • High: 780M tokens/month (full production with additional channels)

- Peak TPS:
  • Regular business peaks: ~22 TPS sustained for 15–30 minutes
  • One-off campaign bursts: up to 120 TPS for ~5 minutes (rare)

- Target budget: $8k–$35k/month depending on band. If you can get close to $10–12 / 1M tokens at the mid band that would be ideal for our CFO.

- Procurement: we typically require a standard SOW + Redlined contract. Procurement is comfortable moving on a 6–12 month term, open to annual pricing if unit economics are right.

Attachments: blueharbor_traffic_sample.csv (sampleed token counts + timestamps).

Sam Bell
Head of Product — BlueHarbor
sam.bell@blueharbor.ai | +1 (617) 222-3344

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: procurement@blueharbor.ai, Sam Bell <sam.bell@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + asks from today's demo — draft SOW and pricing approach

Forwarding our notes and Sam's estimates. Jonas / Karthik — looping you in to propose a draft pricing sheet and a starter SOW. High-level commercial ask from BlueHarbor: hit $10–12 / 1M tokens at ~220M tokens/month (mid band) and support bursts to ~120 TPS.

Preliminary thoughts (please confirm):
- Base assumption: 220M tokens / month, target unit $/1M = $11 (target revenue ~$2,420/month) — note: math check below.  
- Consider 6-12 month committed tier to approach $10–12 / 1M. We can propose a tiered slab with a higher discount at >=250M.
- TPS sizing: sustained 22 TPS is covered by Dedicated pools; Hosted API can handle 120 TPS bursts via autoscaling but needs burst-credit language and a short SLA window.

Jonas — could you produce a quick sensitivity table showing net revenue at $9/$11/$14 per 1M tokens across the three bands Sam provided and include an ops note about burst handling?  Karthik — flag any margin or concessions we shouldn't exceed (e.g., minimum ARR, credit terms).

I'll draft a starter SOW and attach a placeholder. Planning to send to procurement once we have the pricing table + SOW ready.

— Grace

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + asks from today's demo — draft SOW and pricing approach

Thanks — quick run and numbers attached (I'll push the spreadsheet to the Drive folder). Key points:  

- Sensitivity summary (net revenue / month estimate):
  • Low (40M): at $14/1M => $560; at $11/1M => $440; at $9/1M => $360
  • Mid (220M): at $14/1M => $3080; at $11/1M => $2420; at $9/1M => $1980
  • High (780M): at $14/1M => $10,920; at $11/1M => $8,580; at $9/1M => $7,020

- OPS note on burst handling: Hosted API can absorb 120 TPS bursts but we should define burst-credit limits and a 2–5 minute graceful scaling window in the SOW; sustained >60 TPS for >10 minutes should trigger reserved capacity discussion.

- Recommendation: Offer a 12-month commitment at the mid band with $11/1M as the anchor; include an option to true-up quarterly. If procurement needs lower unit price, require a 12-month prepay or a minimum ARR commitment of $75k.

Karthik — anything you'd tweak on concessions? If not, I can finalize the SOW and attach the draft BlueHarbor_SOW_draft.pdf to send to procurement.

Jonas
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
